verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents API-managed debit card issuance tied to accounts, including virtual cards, the full lifecycle (issue, activate, suspend), cards for authorized users on existing accounts, and a Card Auth Loop endpoint to approve or decline transactions in real time. Physical cards are only implied by a card-fulfillment page. Spend controls exist only as developer-defined authorization logic, not documented native limits. missing for 10: explicit physical card issuance evidence, native spend limit or merchant controls, digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) provisioning, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, accounts come with cards — issue virtual and physical debit cards tied to the account through the same API, with spend controls and digital wallet support

citations.quote: Using our API, the entire card lifecycle—from issuing, to activation, to deactivation—can be managed programmatically. With the ability to issue virtual cards, you can get to market quickly
This guide describes how to add authorized users to existing accounts and issue them debit cards.
The Card Auth Loop Endpoint allows you to accept or reject a card transaction at the time of authorization based on your business logic.
Before a card can be used for the first time, it will need to be activated... you can update its status to `suspended`
